diagnosis: The endpoint looks up CustomerInvoice documents in MongoDB using Beanie find_one on invoice_number. It fails to restrict the query by the calling user's account_id or customer_id, allowing any authenticated user to guess or enumerate invoice codes and extract billing amounts, line items, and corporate tax IDs.
exploit_request:
GET /invoices/lookup?invoice_number=INV-2024-ACME9012 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.accountingcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
